actions.action: Require valid passage links before saving definitions
actions.mechanism: Referential integrity prevents definitions from becoming detached from the supplied evidence.
actions.implementation: Store supplied passages by immutable ID. Require each definition variant to reference an existing passage; reject missing or unknown IDs.
actions.check: Attempt saves with missing, unknown, and valid passage IDs. Only the valid case must succeed and resolve to its passage.
actions.risk: A valid link does not establish that the passage supports the wording.

actions.action: Show competing wording beside its evidence
actions.mechanism: An explicit dispute view exposes alternatives without merging their wording or implying consensus.
actions.implementation: Group variants under a term. Display each wording, passage ID, expandable source passage, and recorded objection; label editorial preference separately.
actions.check: Create two conflicting variants. A reader must access both exact wordings, their passages, and the objection from the term view.
actions.risk: Visual ordering can imply endorsement; label ordering and preference explicitly.

actions.action: Flag definitions affected by source corrections
actions.mechanism: Versioned passages preserve historical evidence while dependency tracking identifies definitions needing renewed review.
actions.implementation: Give corrected supplied passages new IDs linked to predecessors. Preserve original links and wording; mark dependent definitions for review without automatically rebinding them.
actions.check: Correct one passage. Only its dependent definitions must be flagged; their original wording and cited passage must remain inspectable.
actions.risk: Repeated corrections can accumulate unresolved review flags.

actions.action: Review disputed terms in bounded batches
actions.mechanism: Limited review scope and explicit stop conditions constrain accidental loss while retaining unresolved alternatives.
actions.implementation: Select five disputed terms. Start only when cited passages resolve; record proposed decisions without overwriting variants. Stop on missing evidence; retain individual review instead.
actions.check: Interrupt a batch after two decisions. All competing wording and links must survive; untouched terms must remain unresolved.
actions.risk: Batch decisions may flatten distinct objections; require a rationale per term.
